name: Lupin
summary: Towering hybrids caught halfway between folk and wolf, with killer claws and a howl that saps the nerve of anyone near.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in Dim Light within 60 feet as if it were Bright Light, and in Darkness as if it were Dim Light.
traits.text: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Feral Pounce
traits.summary: Slashing Unarmed Strikes; once per turn an Attack-action Unarmed Strike hit both damages and Shoves.
traits.text: Your Unarmed Strikes deal Slashing damage, not Bludgeoning. Once per turn, when an Unarmed Strike you make with the Attack action on your own turn hits, you get both its Damage and its Shove option.

traits.name: Howl
traits.summary: Bonus Action: creatures you choose within 15 feet make a Wisdom save (DC 8 + Con + PB) or have Disadvantage on attack rolls and saves until your next turn. PB uses per Long Rest.
traits.text: Bonus Action: you howl. Each creature you choose within 15 feet makes a Wisdom save against DC 8 + your Constitution modifier + your Proficiency Bonus; on a failure its attack rolls and saving throws have Disadvantage until your next turn starts. Uses: your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

traits.name: Werewolf Instincts
traits.summary: Proficiency in Perception, Stealth or Survival.
traits.text: You gain proficiency in one of these skills of your choice: Perception, Stealth or Survival.
